newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Nov 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Nov 29.

text.p: Santen Pharmaceutical Co Ltd and Rohto Pharmaceutical Co Ltd are expected to post record parent current profits in the business year to March 31, 1997, helped by strong sales of new products. Santen is expected to increase its sales by 2.5 times against a year earlier to 4.7 billion yen, while Rohto is expected to triple its sales to 4.15 billion yen.
Canon Sales Co Inc is expected to increase its parent current profit by 42 percent from a year earlier to 22 billion yen in calendar 1996, helped by strong sales of personal computers and printers.

Nichimen Corp applied to the Chinese government for permission to establish a joint trading company with China's largest trading firm. They hope to start the new venture from next spring, and aim for sales of $5 billion annually. The company will be owned 51 percent by the Chinese trading company, more than 25 percent by Nichimen and the remainder by an American or European company.
